comingLast.roast: dead level with Forsyth in the race to the bottom - a photo finish nobody framed
on 16 - every one of his remaining 5 holes is now appointment viewing
on 18 with 4 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
escape number: 3. holes remaining: 3. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
5 more points and the problem becomes Pollock's problem
tied for last with Pollock - one of them buys, both of them stay
1 point clear from the bar - watching Pollock like a hawk with a beer
safe by 1 - unless Pollock finds form, in which case, gulp
clear of Pollock by 1 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
1 point is all that separates him from a very blue evening
